generator_form.name: Name:
generator_form.num_units_tooltip: Identical units the plant at this node is made of. Unit commitment commits a whole number of them, each with rated power / units, its own minimum power, start-ups and min up/down times; availability is the share of units available.
generator_form.fixed_cost_tooltip: Fixed O&M in $ per MW of rated power per year, charged while the unit is in service whether or not it runs (prorated to the simulated hours).
generator_form.startup_cost_tooltip: Cost of starting the whole plant; one of its units costs start-up / units.
generator_form.availability_browse_tooltip: Browse for an availability CSV (hourly profile, values 0-1)
generator_form.risk_coefficient_tooltip: Geographic risk derating factor (0-1). Computed from hazard exposure and component fragility via the Risk Workbench. 1.0 = no derating.

battery_form.name: Name:
battery_form.ramp_tooltip: How fast charge or discharge power may rise (up) or fall (down), as a fraction of the maximum charge / discharge power per hour. 0 = no limit.
battery_form.reservable_tooltip: Its headroom (unused discharge power plus the charging it can stop) counts towards the static and dynamic reserve.
battery_form.fixed_cost_tooltip: Fixed O&M in $ per MW of discharge power per year, charged while the battery is in service whether or not it is used.
battery_form.throughput_degradation_tooltip: Degradation cost per MWh discharged. Represents battery wear from cycling (typical: Li-ion ~5, flow ~2, lead-acid ~15 $/MWh).
battery_form.risk_coefficient_tooltip: Geographic risk derating factor (0-1). Computed from hazard exposure and component fragility via the Risk Workbench. 1.0 = no derating.

line_form.reactance_per_km_tip: Series reactance of this line per km. With the length, it gives the reactance when Reactance (pu) is empty (x = length × X/km ÷ (V² / S_base)). Default = the system's DC power-flow reactance per km.
line_form.circuits_tip: Number of parallel circuits. Capacity, reactance, resistance and susceptance are those of the whole line, all circuits together: changing the count does not rescale them. Only a reactance derived from the reactance per km (one circuit) is divided by it.

zone_form.exclusive_tooltip: When enabled, selected technologies can ONLY invest at this zone. Investment at original nodes is set to zero.

system_form.npv_retirement_tip: Retire the existing generators and batteries whose NPV in the master's plan is below the threshold, and re-solve the master (development runs)
system_form.max_annual_operating_cost_tip: Annual budget of the dispatch for fuel, maintenance and fixed O&M. Spending above it costs 1000 $ per $, so unaffordable fuel becomes unserved energy. 0 = off
system_form.budget_scope_tip: Investment only: the budget caps each build year's overnight investment. Investment + operation: it also covers the money that year spends on operation (fuel, maintenance, fixed O&M; no penalties, no CO2 price)

global_form.n1_crit_line_tip: Run All N-1 and Screening trip only lines and transformers loaded at or above this fraction of their capacity. 0 = all of them.
global_form.n1_sld_header_tip: The settings below are the defaults of the SLD Analysis panel (Run All N-1 and Run Screening). They do not change the optimisation.
global_form.n1_sld_header: SLD contingency analysis (Run All N-1 / Screening):
global_form.title: Global Settings
global_form.model_clock_tip: Time base of every hourly series: hour 0 = 1 Jan 00:00 on this clock, a fixed offset with no daylight saving time. "auto" = the standard time of the zone with most demand, set when the Grid Builder or the availability generator writes the series. Or an IANA zone used at its standard offset (America/Havana), UTC or Etc/GMT+5 (UTC-5).
global_form.n1_scopf_tip: Replace preventive N-1 reserves with security-constrained OPF: post-contingency flow limits (LODF) for every single-line outage, built in one pass.
global_form.n1_corrective_tip: Allow post-contingency battery and generator re-dispatch instead of reserving preventive capacity. Less conservative but more realistic for storage-rich systems.
global_form.n1_security_cost_tip: Re-solve each operational window without the N-1 constraints and report the objective difference as the N-1 security cost. Roughly doubles the solve time. When off, the security cost is reported as 0.
global_form.n1_pi_tip: Performance Index threshold for contingency screening. 0 = no screening (analyze all). Higher values filter low-impact contingencies.
global_form.n1_transformer_ctg_tip: Include transformer outages in N-1 contingency analysis.
global_form.n1_battery_ctg_tip: Include battery/storage outages in N-1 analysis. Discharging batteries act as generation loss.
global_form.mp_critical_days_tip: Days with the lowest renewable supply against demand that the master models besides the representative days (or TSAM periods), one day of the year each, the same for every planning year. 0 = none.
global_form.mp_storage_firm_hours_tip: Hours a battery must sustain its output to count as firm power in the capacity adequacy constraint: it counts min(power, usable energy / hours). Auto = the longest stretch without solar on the critical days.

validation.simplify_tip: Remove dead-end buses, stub lines, and unused fuel elements

validation.infra_no_groups: No mergeable groups found at this scope.
validation.network_reduction_tip: Analyze and suggest equipment merges, parallel line consolidation, bus elimination, and topology reduction.
validation.level_tip:
Simplification level (cumulative):
L1 — Equipment aggregation + parallel lines
L2 — L1 + radial/series bus elimination
L3 — L2 + intra-node voltage collapse
L4 — L3 + full node collapse + small gen absorption
validation.apply_tip: Apply dead-end cleanup and checked network reductions.
validation.apply_level_msg:
Apply Level {level} simplification with auto-repair to {count} system(s)?

The algorithm will iterate until the network is stable and structurally valid.
validation.msg_unknown_key: Unknown key {config_key} is ignored (misspelt or obsolete?) and is not kept when the project is saved
validation.msg_re_increment_conflict: min_annual_increment ({min_inc}) is greater than max_annual_increment ({max_inc}): the RE floor rises faster than the renewable share may grow, so the floor is missed every year and its shortfall is paid. Set min_annual_increment ≤ max_annual_increment.
validation.msg_line_capacity_nonpositive: Line {line}: capacity is zero or negative
validation.msg_line_bad_connection:
Line {line}: Cannot connect {from_type} to {to_type}.

{from_type_cap} can connect to: {targets}
validation.msg_line_bad_connection_none:

{from_type_cap} cannot be connected via transmission lines.
validation.msg_bus_parent_missing: Bus '{name}' ({bus}): parent node {node} does not exist
validation.msg_bus_unused: Bus '{name}' ({bus}): no equipment, no connections, no demand
validation.msg_node_df_sum: Node {node} ({name}): load bus demand fractions sum to {total}, expected 1.0
validation.msg_gen_node_mismatch: Generator '{name}' ({id}): node={node} doesn't match bus '{bus}' parent_node={parent}
validation.msg_gen_min_power: Generator '{name}' ({id}): min_power={value} is outside 0–1 (fraction of rated power)
validation.msg_gen_negative_ramp: Generator '{name}' ({id}): {attr}={value} is negative (fraction of rated power per hour; 0 = no limit)
validation.msg_gen_eff_range: Generator '{name}' ({id}): eff_at_rated={value} out of valid range (0, 1]
validation.msg_gen_retired: Generator '{name}' ({id}): initial_age ({age}) >= life_time ({life}), unit starts retired
validation.msg_bat_node_mismatch: Battery '{name}' ({id}): node={node} doesn't match bus '{bus}' parent_node={parent}
validation.msg_bat_short_duration: Battery '{name}' ({id}): capacity ({capacity} MWh) < rated_power ({power} MW), less than 1 hour at full power
validation.msg_bat_retired: Battery '{name}' ({id}): initial_age ({age}) >= life_time ({life}), unit starts retired
validation.msg_tr_same_voltage: Transformer '{name}': same voltage on both sides ({kv} kV)
validation.msg_tr_power_nonpositive: Transformer '{name}': rated_power_mva is zero or negative
validation.msg_node_gen_no_demand: Node {node} ({name}): has generation equipment but no demand data
validation.msg_node_demand_unloaded: Node {node} ({name}): demand CSV path set but data could not be loaded
validation.msg_zero_peak_demand: System has zero total peak demand across all nodes
validation.msg_demand_lengths_differ: Demand time series have different lengths: {detail}
validation.msg_node_negative_demand: Node {node} ({name}): demand data contains negative values (min={min} MW)
validation.msg_adequacy: Total installed + investable capacity ({capacity} MW) < peak demand ({peak} MW). Adequacy ratio: {ratio}
validation.msg_gen_no_availability: Generator '{name}' ({id}): renewable with rated_power > 0 but no availability file
validation.msg_gen_empty_fuel: Generator '{name}' ({id}): non-renewable unit has empty fuel — the LP would see fuel_cost=0 and 0 emissions, dispatching it as free
validation.msg_gen_fuel_unregistered: Generator '{name}' ({id}): fuel '{fuel}' is not registered in the system fuel catalog
validation.msg_gen_tech_unregistered: Generator '{name}' ({id}): technology '{tech}' is not registered in the system catalog
validation.msg_tech_empty_fuel: Technology '{name}' ({id}): non-renewable tech has empty fuel — investments built from this tech will dispatch as free with 0 emissions
validation.msg_tech_fuel_unregistered: Technology '{name}' ({id}): fuel '{fuel}' is not in the system fuel catalog
validation.msg_fuel_entry_node_missing: Fuel entry '{name}': node {node} does not exist
validation.msg_fuels_unsupplied: Fuels used by generators but not supplied by any fuel entry: {fuels}
validation.msg_route_from_node_missing: Fuel route '{route}': from_node {node} does not exist
validation.msg_route_to_node_missing: Fuel route '{route}': to_node {node} does not exist
validation.msg_route_capacity_nonpositive: Fuel route '{route}': zero or negative capacity
validation.msg_ned_fuel_unsupplied: Non-electric demand '{id}': fuel '{fuel}' not supplied by any fuel entry
validation.msg_subnetworks: Network has {n} disconnected sub-networks (sizes: {sizes}), {with_demand} with demand
validation.reason_dead_end_bus: Dead-end bus: no generation, no demand, leaf connection
validation.reason_stub_route: Stub route to dead-end fuel node '{node}'
validation.reason_dead_end_fuel_entry: Fuel entry '{name}' at dead-end fuel node '{node}' (no fuel consumers)
validation.reason_dead_end_fuel_storage: Fuel storage '{name}' at dead-end fuel node '{node}' (no fuel consumers)

validation.desc_prune_radial_via_transformer: Prune radial bus {bus} (connected to {neighbor} via transformer)
validation.msg_duplicate_plant: Probable duplicate plant: {count} {fuel} units named like '{name}' close together ({members}); if they are the same plant, capacity is over-counted by ~{extra} MW
validation.msg_high_reserve_margin: Installed capacity {capacity} MW is {margin} above peak demand ({peak} MW). Plausible with a lot of solar/wind; otherwise check for duplicate or retired units
validation.msg_bottleneck: Transmission bottleneck: only {deliverable} of {peak} MW peak demand can be delivered through the line/transformer ratings; {unservable} MW that the installed generation could serve is cut off behind under-sized corridors (max-flow check)
validation.msg_topology_audit_crashed: Topology audit crashed ({error_type}: {error}); topology integrity could not be checked. See log for trace.
validation.msg_audit_line_unresolved: Line '{line}': from_bus / to_bus unresolved — the solver will silently drop this line. Run auto-fix or set the endpoints manually.
validation.msg_audit_orphan_bus: Bus '{bus}' has no electrical edges (no lines, transformers, or converters). It forms a one-bus island; remove it or connect it to the grid.
validation.msg_audit_orphan_gen: Generator '{id}': bus reference points to a bus that no longer exists. Solver will drop this generator.
validation.msg_audit_orphan_bat: Battery '{id}': bus reference is invalid. Solver will drop this battery.
validation.msg_audit_surplus_island: Electrical island of {n} bus(es) ({mw} MW gen): {gens}. These buses are interconnected but the whole group has no line, transformer or converter reaching any demand bus — often a real network gap where the link to the main grid was not mapped. Connect the island to the grid or remove the generator(s).
validation.msg_audit_island_gen: Generator '{name}' ({mw} MW, {fuel}) on bus '{bus}' is part of a {n}-bus electrical island with no path to any demand bus. The bus itself is connected locally, but the island as a whole does not reach the main grid.
validation.msg_audit_load_island: Isolated load island of {n} bus(es) around '{bus}' ({n_demand} demand bus(es)): carries demand but has no generation and no path to any generator. The solver can only shed this demand. Connect it to the grid or remove the demand.
validation.msg_audit_inert_component: Component containing bus '{bus}' ({n} buses) has neither generation nor demand — it has no effect on dispatch.
validation.log_removed_bad_ref_lines: Removed {n} line(s) with invalid bus references
validation.log_removed_bad_ref_trafos: Removed {n} transformer(s) with invalid bus references
validation.log_reduction: Equivalent-network reduction (PyPSA-style): {buses} buses → {nodes}-node mesh with {branches} equivalent branch(es); generation + demand co-located per node.
validation.net_line_self_loop: Line '{line}' is a self-loop on bus '{bus}'
validation.net_disconnected_demand: Disconnected demand: buses [{buses}] have demand (frac={frac}) but no generation capacity
validation.net_isolated_generation: Isolated generation: buses [{buses}] have {mw} MW generation but no demand
validation.net_capacity_deficit: Capacity deficit in component: peak demand ~{peak} MW > capacity {capacity} MW
validation.msg_link_from_system_missing: Link {link}: from_system {system} not loaded (silently dropped by runner)
validation.msg_link_to_system_missing: Link {link}: to_system {system} not loaded (silently dropped by runner)
validation.msg_link_same_system: Link {link}: from_system == to_system ({system}); use an intra-system transmission line instead
validation.msg_link_from_endpoint_missing: Link {link}: from_endpoint bus {bus} not in system {system} (polyline may not render)
validation.msg_link_to_endpoint_missing: Link {link}: to_endpoint bus {bus} not in system {system} (polyline may not render)
validation.msg_link_zero_capacity: Link {link}: capacity_mw is 0 — the link will exist in the topology but carry no power; set capacity or max_investment > 0
validation.msg_link_route_no_fuel: Link {link}: fuel route has no fuel — the run ignores it; choose the fuel it carries
validation.msg_link_duplicate_route: Link {link}: duplicate of an earlier fuel route ({ends}); merge the two routes into one
validation.msg_link_duplicate: Link {link}: duplicate of an earlier link ({ends}); merged adjacency uses max() so the second entry is silently ignored
validation.flag_duplicates: {n} probable duplicate plant(s) inflating capacity by ~{mw} MW (same plant counted more than once).
validation.flag_capacity_below_peak: Installed capacity ({capacity} MW) is BELOW peak demand ({peak} MW) — the system cannot meet load (reserve margin {margin}).
validation.flag_high_reserve_margin: Reserve margin is {margin} — implausibly high for a real system (typically 15–40%); capacity is likely over-counted (duplicates / non-operational units).
validation.flag_reference_ratio: Installed capacity {capacity} MW is {ratio}× the reference {reference} MW.
validation.flag_bottleneck: Transmission bottleneck: only {deliverable} of {peak} MW peak demand is deliverable — {unservable} MW that generation could serve is stranded behind under-capacity corridors (max-flow < demand).

grid_builder.substations_generators_transmission_line: Substations, generators, transmission lines, transformers, converters, and storage from OSM.
grid_builder.30_000_power_plants_worldwide_with: ~30,000 power plants worldwide with capacity, fuel type, and location.
grid_builder.global_energy_monitor_power_plant_databa: Global Energy Monitor power plant database (Feb 2025). More recent than WRI (2021) with similar coverage.
grid_builder.minimum_voltage_for_substations_and_line: Minimum voltage for substations and lines. 110 kV = high-voltage transmission. 33 kV = includes sub-transmission.
grid_builder.minimum_generator_capacity_set_to_0: Minimum generator capacity for a transmission-scale grid. Scales automatically with Min voltage — a plant below it (e.g. small distributed PV) connects at distribution level, not to the transmission network, and would only appear as a stranded island. Edit by hand to pin a fixed value; set to 0 to include every generator.
grid_builder.recommended_separate_bus_per_voltage_lev: Recommended: separate bus per voltage level in multi-voltage substations, with auto-created transformer between them.
grid_builder.gridfinder_tooltip: ML-predicted line routes from satellite night-lights. Geometry only — voltage/capacity are derived from the network each line connects. Fills gaps where OSM lacks transmission lines.
grid_builder.choose_which_system_to_assign_the: Choose which system to assign the built elements to.
grid_builder.automatically_create_nodes_from_spatial_: Automatically create nodes from spatial clustering
grid_builder.minimum_number_of_nodes_to_create: Minimum number of nodes to create.
grid_builder.maximum_number_of_nodes_to_create: Maximum number of nodes to create.
grid_builder.after_building_write_a_per_generator: After building, write a per-generator availability CSV next to the YAML (or in ./availability/). Synthetic for thermal / hydro / geothermal / biomass; real weather-based capacity factors for wind/solar (Open-Meteo; adds ~30 s per wind/solar generator).
grid_builder.faithful_import_only_buses_of_the:
Faithful import only. Buses of the same voltage within this radius
are treated as one physical station and merged — this is what
connects each line endpoint to its substation. It is a 'same
station' tolerance, not a reach: lines are never snapped to a far
bus. Increase it if large substations still split into separate
components; decrease it if two distinct stations get merged.
grid_builder.simplification_applied_after_build_auto_: Simplification applied after the build, before the network is drawn. Higher levels = simpler network, fewer buses/lines, faster downstream simulation.
grid_builder.drop_isolated_subgraphs_smaller_than_thi: Drop isolated subgraphs smaller than this, e.g. remote single-substation 'islands' from OSM that no line joins to the main grid. Set to 1 to disable; the largest component is always kept regardless.
grid_builder.click_on_the_map_to_place: Click on the map to place the node centroid (ESC to cancel).
grid_builder.b_step_6_demand_forecast_distribution:
Step 3: Demand Forecast & Distribution
Generate hourly demand profiles per node using ML models, then distribute among busbars via building density.
grid_builder.detect_country_from_polygon_centroid_via: Detect country from polygon centroid via Nominatim
grid_builder.override_total_national_demand_0_auto: Override the total national demand (GWh/yr); the forecast is scaled to it. 0 = automatic: the Archetype engine uses World Bank kWh/capita × population; the XGBoost engines keep the model's own total.
grid_builder.shared_socioeconomic_pathway_for_the_gdp:
Shared Socioeconomic Pathway for the GDP trajectory. The demand
forecast follows the gridded SSP GDP path (per node, year by year),
replacing a fixed growth rate. SSP2 = middle-of-the-road.
grid_builder.import_your_own_observed_hourly_demand: Import your own observed hourly demand for a node to validate the forecast and, optionally, bend it toward the observation. The correction scales the forecast by a month×hour factor derived from the base year and applies it to every year, so the future growth trajectory is preserved.
grid_builder.open_the_chart_with_the_observed: Open the chart with the observed series overlaid on the forecast.
grid_builder.scale_the_forecast_so_the_base: Scale the forecast so the base year matches your observed series in each (month, hour) bin; the same factor is applied to all years so growth is preserved.
grid_builder.distribute_each_node_s_forecast_demand: Distribute each node’s forecast demand among its busbars. Prefer “Distribute by spatial demand” (uses the model’s per-cell demand directly); building footprints remain as an alternative. Only nodes with ≥ 2 buses need distribution.
grid_builder.assign_each_0_25_demand_density:
Assign each 0.25° demand-density cell from the forecast to its
nearest bus and split each node's demand by the cells' demand.
Uses the model's actual spatial demand instead of building
footprints. Requires the density-engine forecast to be run first.

risk_panels.site_intro:
Site Overview & Hazard Screening

Shows detected system nodes and a categorical hazard screening derived from the fetched intensity data. The screening levels update automatically when hazard data is fetched.
risk_panels.no_nodes_load_system: No node coordinates detected. Load a system first.

No hazard intensity data available yet.

Switch to the Hazard Data tab and click 'Fetch Selected Hazards' to download data from USGS, IBTrACS, NOAA, NASA FIRMS, and other sources.
risk_panels.him_by_node_max_rp: Hazard Intensity Measures by Node (max return period)
risk_panels.hazard_data_intro:
Hazard Data Manager

Fetch and manage hazard intensity data from multiple sources. Supports seismic (USGS/GEM), cyclone (IBTrACS/STORM), flood (WRI Aqueduct), tsunami (NOAA), wildfire (NASA FIRMS), volcanic (Smithsonian GVP), and sea level rise (NASA AR6).

risk_panels.no_rp_msg: Select at least one return period.
risk_panels.fragility_intro:
Fragility Library Editor

Browse and edit lognormal fragility curves. 49 built-in curves from NHESS-2024 and PNNL-33587. Edit parameters to see live CDF updates.
risk_panels.reset_library_msg: Reset all curves to built-in defaults? Custom curves will be lost.
risk_panels.dashboard_intro:
Risk Dashboard

Run composite risk assessment combining all fetched hazard data with the fragility library. Tune CVaR parameters and combination method to explore risk sensitivity.
risk_panels.no_nodes_selected_msg: Select at least one node to analyze.
risk_panels.climate_intro:
Climate Scenarios & Demand Adjustment

Configure SSP climate pathways and preview their impact on renewable availability and electricity demand via HDD/CDD.
risk_panels.demand_sensitivity_info: Demand increase per 1°C warming (cooling) or cooling (heating). Typical: 2–4 %/°C cooling, 1–2 %/°C heating.
risk_panels.no_ssp_msg: Select at least one SSP pathway.
risk_panels.scenario_tree_intro:
Scenario Tree

Generate and manage discrete hazard scenarios for the stochastic optimizer. Edit probabilities, add manual scenarios, or reduce the tree using forward reduction.
risk_panels.no_risk_profiles_msg: Run risk assessment first in the Risk Dashboard tab.
risk_panels.export_intro:
Export & Apply

Review the complete risk analysis configuration and export results or apply to the system configuration.
risk_panels.apply_no_state: No risk analysis state. Run the assessment first.
risk_panels.apply_no_model: No GUI model available. The workbench must be opened from the main editor window.
risk_panels.step_risk_intro:
Step 1: Risk Analysis

Compute composite risk indices, expected annual loss (EAL), and per-element risk coefficients. The Fragility Library tab allows reviewing the damage curves used in the assessment.
risk_panels.step_scenarios_intro:
Step 2: Scenarios

Configure climate projections (SSP pathways, demand adjustment) and disaster scenarios (per-hazard damage fractions). These scenarios drive the stochastic optimization.
risk_panels.step_results_intro:
Step 3: Results & Export

Review the complete risk analysis summary. Export results as CSV, JSON, YAML, or ISO 31000 HTML report. Click Apply in the bottom bar to write risk coefficients and scenarios to the system configuration.

otec_studio.panel_site_purpose: Pick site(s); CMEMS/HYCOM data, multi-depth profiles, SSP climate scenario, siting hazard layers (MPA/AIS/seismic/cyclone).
otec_studio.panel_cycle_purpose: Cycle & fluid with Kalina/Uehara composition and hybrid power-split; live T-s / P-h thermodynamic diagram per design point.
otec_studio.panel_optimization_purpose: Inverse design: optimize_site + UserConstraints to minimize LCOE, plus an evaluate() grid that draws the LCOE surface around the optimum.
otec_studio.panel_operation_purpose: Per-site otec_operation time-series with regulation-limit diagnostics (turbine vs condenser vs evaporator pinch).
otec_studio.panel_economics_purpose: CAPEX/OPEX breakdown, degradation models, NPV-LCOE, cost schemes, depth-cost tradeoff.
otec_studio.panel_uncertainty_purpose: Monte Carlo / Sobol / Tornado over a selectable output metric with editable distributions, reused across scenarios.
otec_studio.panel_regional_purpose: Batch inverse-design across every site in a region (run_regional_optimization) with region-wide constraint what-ifs; LCOE site map + portfolio summary + CSV/HDF5 export.
otec_studio.scenario_new_tip: Start a fresh scenario with default config
otec_studio.scenario_branch_tip: Clone the active scenario's config (shares downloaded data) to vary one knob and compare
otec_studio.cycle_apply_tip: Push cycle / fluid / NH₃ concentration into the active scenario so the Optimization panel uses them
otec_studio.cycle_applied: Applied to scenario — Optimization will use this cycle (cached results were invalidated).
otec_studio.cycle_t_order_error: T evaporator must exceed T condenser.
otec_studio.eco_run_hint: Run an analysis to see results.

otec_studio.opt_constraints_hint: Without any cap, LCOE falls monotonically with size → the optimum degenerates to the max-power bound. Enable a cap to find the real cost/size sweet spot.
otec_studio.opt_same_axes: Choose two different axes for the surface.
otec_studio.reg_cluster_zones_tip: DBSCAN-cluster feasible sites into development zones (polygons)
otec_studio.reg_run_hint: Run a region to see results.
otec_studio.res_use_as_resource_tip: Push the selected site into the project so Optimization / Economics / Operation auto-fill from it
otec_studio.res_characterize_tip: Monthly ΔT / temperature pattern + Carnot ceiling for the site (synthetic seasonal series when no CMEMS daily data is attached)
